offering_description.value: DHI Group operates online recruiting marketplaces for technology professionals and professionals with active U.S. security clearances. It uses AI-powered tools and a proprietary skills algorithm to match candidates with employers’ open roles.

quotes.quote: DHI Group, Inc. is a family of purpose-built talent platforms - each built for a specific professional community, not a one-size-fits-all marketplace. DHI Group powers ClearanceJobs and Dice, the platforms top tech talent turn to and employers rely on. Our AI-powered tools and proprietary skills algorithm do the heavy lifting, matching the right candidate to the right opening, fast.

ClearanceJobs is the leading marketplace for professionals with active U.S. security clearances, serving multiple customers, including Lockheed Martin, Booz Allen Hamilton, Leidos, Raytheon, and many others. ClearanceJobs has 2 million cleared candidate profiles, reinforcing our position as the industry's premier destination for cleared technology talent.

primary_products.value: Technology recruiting marketplace; security-cleared recruiting marketplace

quotes.quote: Dice is the largest technology-focused talent marketplace in the United States, built over more than 35 years with nearly 8 million technology profiles.
